newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-Handelsbanken Q1 profit seen 8 pct higher.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Handelsbanken Q1 profit seen 8 pct higher.

text.p: Handelsbanken was expcted on Monday to report a profit after credit losses of 1.64 billion crowns for the first quarter of 1997 against 1.52 billion crowns a year ago, a Reuters poll found.
Forecasts from 10 analysts varied between 1.48 billion and 1.81 billion crowns.
Credit losses were expected to be, on average, 441 million crowns for the period against 449 million in the first quarter of 1996.
For the full year, the bank's profit after credit losses was expected to rise to 6.89 billion crowns from 6.72 billion crowns a year ago.
In 1998 the bank's profit was expected to rise to 7.40 billion crowns.
Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Aros, Carnegie, Den Norske Bank, Enskilda, Fiba Nordic, James Capel, Morgan Stanley, Nordbanken, SBC Warburg, and Swedbanken.
